banter: Doc squares the deck without looking down. "Ante's ante, friend. The felt doesn't care who you were out there."
"Cards fall how they fall. Only cheat I ever caught in here, we buried facing down so he'd keep losing."
He fans the deck one-handed. "Sit if you're sitting. The Reach doesn't wait, and neither do I."
description: A spare, courtly man with a card-sharp's still hands and a mortician's patience, dealing from a shoe he shuffles by feel. They call him Doc because he'll tell you exactly how your night is going to die. He runs a straight game — not from virtue, but because in the Reach a crooked dealer is a short-term position.

clothing_layers: a threadbare dealer's waistcoat, watch-chain missing its watch
a collarless white shirt with biting sleeve garters

name: Ambrose "Doc" Teller
